quotes.confounding: Multivariate, stepwise logistic regression analysis to identify those independently associated with mortality.
quotes.selection: From January 1, 2009, through December 31, 2010, consecutive patients who received at least 1 unit of PRBCs within 24 hours of admission following combat-related injury were identified...
quotes.classification: Patients who received TXA were assigned to the treatment group (TXA group) and compared with those who did not receive TXA (no-TXA group).
quotes.deviations: As part of a major hemorrhage protocol or clinical practice guideline, TXA was administered...
quotes.missingData: Data collected included demographic characteristics, admission physiology, treatment timelines, and 24-hour transfusion requirement... from prospectively collected UK and US trauma registries.
quotes.measurement: In-hospital mortality... secondary endpoints included transfusion requirements and coagulation parameters...
quotes.reporting: All prespecified clinical outcomes such as mortality, PE, and DVT were reported in tables.
quotes.overall: A retrospective cohort study was performed with patients having been treated at a single surgical hospital.
